description:
Captain Carrot and His Amazing Zoo Crew! #2 and #3 (April - May 1982), DC Comics. 60 cent cover price each.

- #2: Pig-Iron and Armordillo vs. the Zoo Crew - "Not just another funny animal comic!" Back cover: Monogram Hot Wheels snap model kits ad
- #3: vs. the croaking colossus Frogzilla! Scott Shaw cover. Back cover: Gabriel Lone Ranger Western Town mail-in offer ad (coupon intact)

Condition: both bright with light handling wear; #2 has a small handwritten "C-852" at the lower left of the front cover and a lightly toned back cover (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
